description: This is a unit test class for the TimesheetActionLogAPI, testing the API endpoints related to timesheet action logs within the OrangeHRM HRM system. It includes setup, data-driven testing for the 'getAll' method, and tests for unimplemented methods such as create, delete, and their validation rules.

classes.name: TimesheetActionLogAPITest
classes.description: A test class for API endpoints related to TimesheetActionLog within OrangeHRM, extending endpoint integration test cases and verifying API behaviors.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment by clearing the entity manager.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests the 'getAll' API endpoint of TimesheetActionLogAPI using data provider.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test case data for testing the 'getAll' method.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the create method is not implemented and throws an exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rules for create are not implemented.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the delete method is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Verifies that the validation rules for delete are not implemented.
